tasks: Identify major support and resistance levels
Mark premium zones (above equilibrium) and discount zones (below equilibrium)
Identify external liquidity (swing highs/lows) and internal liquidity (FVGs, order blocks)
Determine market condition: bullish, bearish, or ranging
Identify all BOS (Break of Structure) on 15M and 30M
Identify MSS (Market Structure Shift) — this is the primary entry trigger
Report the most recent MSS and its direction (bullish or bearish)
Identify buy-side liquidity (equal highs, highs above key levels)
Identify sell-side liquidity (equal lows, lows below key levels)
Determine whether liquidity has already been swept on each timeframe
Estimate the next most probable liquidity target

long_setup: 3. Bullish FVG or Bullish Order Block identified
4. Entry on retracement into FVG or Order Block
short_setup: 3. Bearish FVG or Bearish Order Block identified
4. Entry on retracement into FVG or Order Block

no_trades_during: Any high-impact USD or XAU news within 30 minutes
risk_rules.news_block_rule: If a high-impact news event is scheduled within the next 30 minutes, return: NO TRADE — HIGH IMPACT NEWS RISK.

macro_filter.dxy_rule: If DXY is strongly bullish, bias XAUUSD bearish. If DXY is weakening, bias XAUUSD bullish.
macro_filter.us10y_rule: Rising US10Y yields are bearish pressure on Gold. Falling yields support Gold.

required_sections: TRADE_SETUP: { direction, entry, stop_loss, take_profit_1, take_profit_2, risk_reward }
REASONING: concise explanation based on liquidity, MSS, market structure, DXY, and macro conditions
